text: $MARSCOINUSDT ripped up 30.8% to $0.1547, flashing a high of $0.169 while volume swelled past 64 M USDT. $HBARUSDT followed, climbing 24.2% to $0.12019 and topping out at $0.13096, with over 212 M USDT changing hands.
